data.ruling: The refutation does not stand against the part. Only one refutation was raised: the datasheet verifier's "charge voltage" check. The stock and lifecycle verifier confirmed every figure and raised nothing. The verifier's correction of the figure is right. At 8.4 V the data sheet gives -0.6 % to +0.6 %, not +/-0.5 %. The part still meets every requirement value of the function. No value in IOBoard.md or in the Answer and Decision columns of Research.md sets a charge-voltage tolerance. V138 (charge voltage per cell: 4.2 V, or the cell's own figure) is still "for research". With MaxChargeVoltage at 8400 mV, the part regulates to 4.2 V a cell nominal. The Molicel P26A and M30A and the Sony VTC6 data sheets each give 4.2 V as the charge voltage with no tolerance, so +/-0.6 % fails no gate that +/-0.5 % would pass. The verifier reached the same result: its own check reads agrees=false, passes=true, and it wrote "the requirement passes". Research.md states that a part stays unless it is refuted, and that a standing refutation sends the next-ranked candidate to new verifiers. A wrong figure on a gate the part still passes is a correction to record, not grounds to drop the part. Corrected figure to carry forward: VBAT_REG_ACC at REG0x05/04 = 0x20D0 (8.4 V), 0 to 85 degC, is -0.6 % to +0.6 %. That is 8.3496 to 8.4504 V for the pack and 4.1748 to 4.2252 V a cell. The data sheet's front-page line "+/-0.5 % charge voltage regulation" holds only at 12.6 V and 16.8 V. A note for P5 and the cross-category check: R5's V92 return in the T3 scratch (P2-R5/return.min.json) designs the pack path for 8.44 V. It takes 2 x 4.221 V from the BQ25887 seed, not from the BQ25713. With the BQ25713 the pack can reach 8.4504 V, 10.4 mV above that design value. That mismatch is for P5 to reconcile; it is not a defect of this part in this function. The port ceiling of 8.7 V (F16) stays above 8.4504 V. The verifier's claim that R6 (V131) and V150 carry 8.442 V was not re-read here.
data.evidence: SLUSD83C (header "SLUSD83C - JUNE 2018 - REVISED MAY 2023"), section 8.5, CHARGE VOLTAGE REGULATION. VBAT_RNG is 1.024 to 19.2 V. VBAT_REG_ACC ("Battery voltage regulation accuracy (charge enable) (0 degC to 85 degC)") reads: 0x41A0H 16.8 V -0.5 %/+0.5 %; 0x3138H 12.6 V -0.5 %/+0.5 %; 0x20D0H 8.4 V -0.6 %/+0.6 %; 0x1068H 4.2 V -1.1 %/+1.2 %. The features line on page 1 reads "+/-0.5% Charge voltage regulation". 8.4 V x 0.994 = 8.3496 V and 8.4 V x 1.006 = 8.4504 V. Charge voltage in the cell data sheets, from the P4 datasheet verifier's scratch copies, not re-fetched: Molicel INR-18650-P26A "Cell Voltage Charge 4.2 V"; Molicel INR-18650-M30A "Cell Voltage Charge 4.2 V"; Sony VTC6 "Charge: CCCV, 3.0 A, 4.2 V". Requirement values at checkout e13f5f6: IOBoard.md:358 names one Pack charger, 2S lithium-ion, with no tolerance. Research.md:698 V138 reads "for research (owner, 2026-09-28)". R5's V92 value is "8.44 V: 2 x 4.221 V ... of the R7 seed charger BQ25887" (scratch/T3/P2-R5/return.min.json).
